notes: Zara Home India has no dedicated country storefront; per notes/242.md (prior Home-Decor pass) India is served through the shared 'Rest of World' catalogue at https://www.zarahome.com/ww/ (storeId 88009900, catalogId 80290026), confirmed empirically via /in/ redirecting to /es/ and the site's own store-list API listing India (countryCode IN) with the identical storeId/catalogId pair as the literal 'WW' entry. Accessed via curl_cffi chrome impersonation + the existing Akamai interstitial POW solver (pipeline/final_list_batch_sn21-30/inditex_interstitial_solver.py), same route as the prior pass. robots.txt fetched in full (5840 bytes): no Claude/ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow. CHECKED FOR PET CARE: (1) fetched the full server-rendered homepage (774KB, contains the complete menu-v2 mega-menu tree with all levels inline in the SSR HTML) and grepped case-insensitively for 'pet', 'dog', 'cat', 'animal', 'paw' across the ENTIRE page - zero matches anywhere. (2) The mega-menu's 8 top-level nodes are exactly BEDDING, HOME DECOR, BATHROOM, KIDS AND BABY, CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR, LAUNDRY CARE, CULINARY STORIES (editorial, not product), WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS - no Pets node, matching the prior pass's finding that this catalogue is much smaller than the dedicated-store countries (also missing Lighting, Mirrors, Kitchen & Dining entirely). (3) Guessed the UAE-style nav URL /ww/pets-collection-n1561 -> 404. (4) Fetched robots.txt sitemap indexes and the dedicated WW-catalogue sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-ww-0.xml.gz, 303KB decompressed) - zero genuine pet-category URLs (only a false-positive substring match inside 'espetos', Portuguese for skewers). (5) Google site-search for site:zarahome.com/ww/ pets-collection returned nothing. DESPITE all of that, direct-probed the category grid API (itxrest/3/catalog/store/88009900/80290026/category/<id>/product) using categoryId 1020752407 - the same internal id that UAE's (SR21) own nav resolves 'PETS COLLECTION' to - and it returned 200 with REAL content: a 'Pet capsulas' grid of 22 unique productIds (STRIPED PET HARNESS, STRIPED PET BANDANA, STRIPED AND FAUX SHEEPSKIN PET BED, STRIPED AND SHEARLING PET BLANKET, RUG/BANDANA/PET TOYS bundle, GINGHAM PET TOPPER, GINGHAM PET BLANKET, FROG PET TOY, etc - genuine Tier-1 pet products, not pet-themed). Verified one product page is live: https://www.zarahome.com/ww/striped-pet-harness-l42333149.html returned 200 with full product detail (description 'Pet harness with adjustable straps'). HOWEVER this category has NO live discoverable path on the India storefront: not in the mega-menu, not in the sitemap, the guessed short-URL 404s, and the product page's own HTML contains no breadcrumb link back to any pet category page. It appears to be a shared-taxonomy backend artifact (same category id happens to resolve on both UAE's dedicated store and this WW catalogue) rather than something India customers can actually browse to. Recording it per the brief's 'record it, don't silently drop it' principle but flagging the reachability ambiguity for manual review rather than deciding it myself. qty=22 taken from the exact length of the category API's own 'productIds' array (same method the prior Home-Decor pass validated for this exact site/store). No other Pet Care content found anywhere else on the site (not nested under Home Decor, Kids and Baby, Bathroom, etc - full-page keyword scan covered those too).
